root_cause: No default scroll action outside text editing. The runtime key router handled PageUp/PageDown and arrows only for text fields, selectable text and menus. Flutter WidgetsApp maps PageUp/PageDown to ScrollIntent(page) and Ctrl+arrows to ScrollIntent(line) on non-web targets.
change: crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs (run_default_focus_key, called before the text-field fallthrough for non-text focus targets); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/focus.rs (scroll_nearest_viewport: nearest viewport chain entry, 0.8 viewport for page or 50 px for line, clamped to [0, max_offset], animate_to 100 ms EaseInOut; consumed even at the edge, as Flutter's ScrollAction does)
harness: focus_input__keyboard_page_scroll: offset now matches on every frame (was max 480 px). Residual value.row_focused diverges from frame 6 (Flutter 0, Incular 1); see limitations.
api_change: none (new pub method WidgetTree::scroll_nearest_viewport in the internal tree module)
limitations: Flutter's ScrollAction also checks the scrollable's physics (shouldAcceptUserOffset); not checked here. Residual: after the PageDown scroll, Flutter drops focus from the autofocused row (row_focused 0 from frame 6) and Incular keeps it. The cause is not verified. The likely area is off-cache list item disposal, which is outside this group's files and was not changed.
note: Ctrl+arrow and PageUp/PageDown reach only the nearest viewport. Home/End are not mapped, as in Flutter's non-web defaults.

root_cause: Arrow keys drove only menu focus (menu_directional_focus_target). Flutter binds plain arrows to DirectionalFocusIntent, implemented by DirectionalFocusTraversalPolicyMixin, and Incular had no geometric directional query.
change: crates/incular-gestures/src/focus.rs (TraversalDirection, DirectionalFocusCandidate, directional_focus_index: Flutter _findNextFocusInDirection with in-band and closest-edge selection, scroll-owner preference, closed-loop wrap, and first-in-direction when nothing is focused); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/focus.rs (directional_focus_target over reading-ordered focusable elements and their bounds); crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs (arrows with no modifiers, after the text-field check so text editing keeps arrows)
api_change: additive: new public items in incular-gestures (TraversalDirection, DirectionalFocusCandidate, directional_focus_index)
limitations: No hysteresis history (Flutter _popPolicyDataIfNeeded). Candidates are all focusable elements of the tree, not only the nearest FocusScope's traversal descendants. LTR only. Shift, Alt and Meta chords are not mapped, as in Flutter.
note: The FocusManager node path (FocusTraversalPolicy trait) has no directional query; only the runtime path was changed.

root_cause: FocusScope::new installed FocusTraversalPolicyKind::WidgetOrder. Flutter's FocusScope inherits the default ReadingOrderTraversalPolicy.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/focus_keyboard.rs (FocusScope::new and a manual Default both use ReadingOrder; the derived Default is replaced; widget_order() keeps registration order)
api_change: behaviour change: FocusScope without an explicit policy now traverses in reading order. Migration: call .widget_order() to keep the old order. The Default impl is now manual, with the same fields.
limitations: Only the default-policy case was compared. The node-level FocusManager default (FocusTraversalPolicyKind::default, WidgetOrder) is unchanged.

root_cause: Reading order used a row-height tolerance (0.5 * height + 1) in two copies: incular-gestures/src/focus.rs, and the runtime path incular-widgets/src/tree.rs sort_focus_members, which Tab traversal actually uses. Flutter groups by band overlap: pick the topmost item, take the items vertically overlapping it, and emit the left-most.
change: crates/incular-gestures/src/focus.rs (reading_order_by: Flutter _pickNext band algorithm, public and generic over a rect accessor; FocusNode reading order calls it); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree.rs (sort_focus_members ReadingOrder branch calls incular_gestures::reading_order_by; signature now takes &mut Vec; out-of-ownership edit)
api_change: additive: incular_gestures::reading_order_by is new and public
limitations: LTR only: Flutter sorts each band right-to-left under RTL. The tree's reading order does not read the text direction.
note: The helper lives in incular-gestures so both copies share one implementation; incular-widgets already depends on that crate.

root_cause: OrderedTraversalPolicy sorted by order, then by registration sequence, so unordered and equal-order nodes kept construction order. Flutter sorts with the ReadingOrder secondary policy first, then stable-sorts by order.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree.rs (sort_focus_members Ordered branch: reading order first, then a stable sort by order with no sequence tie-break); crates/incular-gestures/src/focus.rs (policy_nodes and OrderedTraversalPolicy use explicit_order(reading_order(...)))
limitations: No dedicated unit test was added; the ordered-policy branch is covered only by the frame scenario. Only unordered nodes and distinct numeric orders were compared, not equal numeric orders.

root_cause: Enter events for mouse regions followed hit.raw() (frontmost first). Flutter MouseTracker sends enter events in reverse hit-test order, so outer regions enter before inner ones. Exit order already matched.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/raw_input.rs (enter_callbacks iterate the entering set in reverse; focus behaviour order unchanged)
limitations: Two nested regions only, as in the scenario. Focus behaviours still enter in their original order relative to mouse regions.
